description: Request how new documents of a DocType are named: its autoname / naming series options, or a Document Naming Rule (prefix + counter, with conditions); the user approves it

autoname.description: set_doctype_naming: naming_series: | field:<fieldname> | INV-.YYYY.-.##### (expression, needs #) | format:INV-{YYYY}-{#####} | hash | prompt

naming_series_options.description: set_doctype_naming: the full list of series offered in the naming_series field, first = default, e.g. ["INV-.YYYY.-", "RET-.YYYY.-"]

rule.description: update_rule / disable_rule / enable_rule: the Document Naming Rule's name

prefix.description: create_rule / update_rule: e.g. EXP-.YYYY.- (date parts and {fieldname} allowed, no #)

conditions.description: All must match for the rule to name a document; none = every document

purpose.description: One line: why the user wants it (shown on the card)
